name: Prashant India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Prashant India Ltd is in the business of manufacturing yarn, wind power generation, and oil extraction[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) PIL operates as a manufacturer, seller, 
and exporter of agro products, textiles, 
and wind power generation.
b) The agro unit in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, 
includes an oil mill, solvent extraction 
plant, and oil refinery as part of its 
manufacturing facility.
c) The textile unit in Dist. Surat, Gujarat, specializes in sizing, texturizing, and twisting 
of yarn, with an annual production capacity of 1650 MT, 2010 MT, and 210 MT, respectively.
d) The wind farm unit is located in Dist. Rajkot, Gujarat, with a power generation capacity of 1 MW per year, utilizing 5 wind energy generators (WEGs), each with a capacity of 200KW.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -41.3% over past five years.
Company has high debtors of 265 days.
